toegepas.blok: Toe 'n brief nog self moes reis
toegepas.voor: Mense het dae gewag vir nuus en soms weke of selfs maande
toegepas.na: Mense het dae en soms weke of selfs maande vir nuus gewag
toegepas.rede_vinder: The prepositional phrase belongs before the final verb, and the trailing 'en soms weke' reads as an afterthought.
toegepas.fout: The trailing 'en soms weke of selfs maande' after 'vir nuus' reads as a loose afterthought.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Grouping all the durations before 'vir nuus gewag' reads naturally and keeps the meaning exactly.

toegepas.voor: dat elektrisiteit deur drade boodskappe oor groot afstande kan dra
toegepas.na: dat elektrisiteit boodskappe deur drade oor groot afstande kan dra
toegepas.rede_vinder: Putting the object before the 'deur drade' phrase makes the sentence easier to follow.
toegepas.fout: 'deur drade boodskappe' puts the means before the object and reads stiffly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Object before the 'deur drade' phrase is the natural order, same meaning.

toegepas.voor: aan die telegraaf gewerk en Morse
toegepas.na: aan die telegraaf gewerk, en Morse
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Meer as een mens het ... gewerk' and 'Morse was een van hulle' are full clauses, so the comma is required.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die sender druk ... af' and 'elektrisiteit beweeg' are full clauses.

toegepas.na: kon dus net boodskappe stuur waar
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Stuur' without an object reads incomplete; naming what is sent adds no content.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'boodskappe' completes the verb without adding any fact; the protected 'telegraaf' is untouched.

toegepas.na: 'n kort sein is 'n kolletjie, en 'n lang sein

toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both halves have their own subject and 'is', so the comma is required; no protected word changes.

toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb.

toegepas.na: Nuus het vinnig versprei, en 'n hele land

toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: kon vinniger handel dryf oor groot afstande
toegepas.na: kon vinniger oor groot afstande handel dryf
toegepas.rede_vinder: In Afrikaans the phrase goes before the verb group at the end, not after it.
toegepas.fout: The phrase trails after the final verb group, which reads loose.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Placing 'oor groot afstande' before 'handel dryf' is the natural Afrikaans order with no change in meaning.

toegepas.voor: Teen die laat 1800's het telegraafkabels selfs onder die see geloop
toegepas.na: Teen die einde van die 1800's het telegraafkabels selfs onder die see deur geloop
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die laat 1800's' copies English 'the late 1800s', and 'onder die see deur' is the natural Afrikaans for running under something.
toegepas.fout: 'die laat 1800's' copies English, and 'onder die see geloop' lacks the natural 'deur'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both fixes are idiomatic Afrikaans and the claim stays the same (cables ran under the sea by late in that century).

laat_vaar.voor: Die twee stede lê naby mekaar en 'n brief
laat_vaar.na: Die twee stede lê naby mekaar, maar 'n brief
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The two clauses stand in contrast (close together, yet hours), so 'maar' with its comma states the link the sentence already implies.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Swapping 'en' for 'maar' adds a contrast the original does not assert (the contrast is with the telegraph's minutes in the next sentence), and the original reads fine.

vlae.teks: Baie mense dink SOS staan vir 'Save Our Souls' of 'Save Our Ship'.
vlae.rede: 'Staan vir' is an anglicism, but the natural fix ('beteken') would reproduce the NIE wording 'SOS beteken Save Our Souls', so it is left for a person; this is not a safety matter.

vlae.teks: 'n Kode wat elke letter as kolletjies en strepies skryf.
vlae.rede: 'Skryf' is odd for a code that is mostly sent as sounds or signals; a better verb may be wanted, but choosing one touches what the definition says, so it is flagged rather than changed.
